text: The snooze and dismiss catches use logger.warn, identify the item and say the alarm will be ignored, then pass the caught exception as a separate argument. Keep the outcome text and the actual exception distinct in this local diagnostic pattern. The source does not establish which stack details a logger renders. title: Alarm write warnings keep the exception separate from item and outcome text
